annotations.title: Which indicators the price is following

description: Nineteen market indicators (order-book imbalance, market and whale order flow, liquidations, whale-wallet positions, funding, futures premium, top traders' ratio, open interest, exchange flows, bid-ask spread) graded against what the price did in the 15 minutes after each reading, from a minute-by-minute record of BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE and HYPE that is graded again every hour. Each indicator gets a verdict: price followed it, price went against it, or no steady link. Answers "which crypto indicators actually work right now", "does funding rate predict price" and "is order-book imbalance a reliable signal". Live market data, not advice.
name: indicator_scoreboard
title: Which indicators the price is following
